name: Exp_BykovTrend_ReOpen
summary: This EA implements the BykovTrend trend-following indicator strategy with a ReOpen feature that allows re-entering positions in the same direction after a prior exit. It trades based on trend signal confirmation from the BykovTrend indicator and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了BykovTrend趋势跟踪指标策略，并带有ReOpen（重新开仓）功能，允许在前期出场后沿同方向重新进场。它基于BykovTrend指标的趋势信号确认进行交易，并通过可配置的止损和止盈水平管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于BykovTrend指标进行趋势跟踪交易，该指标通常通过价格与移动平均线的关系或ATR波动幅度来判断趋势方向。入场条件为BykovTrend指标发出买入或卖出信号时开仓，ReOpen功能允许在趋势延续时重复开仓加码。出场条件包括固定的止损和止盈水平，也可能在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA允许固定手数交易，ReOpen功能实质上是一种趋势延续时的加仓策略。资金管理方面，EA依赖预设的止损止盈比来控制风险，但ReOpen加仓可能导致持仓总量超过预期，增加风险敞口。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能因频繁假信号而亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the BykovTrend indicator, which typically determines trend direction through price relative to moving averages or ATR-based volatility bands. Entry conditions trigger when the BykovTrend indicator generates a buy or sell signal, and the ReOpen feature allows re-entering or adding positions when the trend continues in the same direction. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, and positions may also close on opposing signals. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes, while the ReOpen mechanism effectively acts as a trend-continuation pyramiding strategy. Money management relies on preset stop loss and take profit ratios to control risk, though the ReOpen feature can cause total position size to exceed expectations, increasing risk exposure. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for strongly trending markets, but may suffer losses in choppy markets due to frequent false signals.

parameters.description_en: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰，在强趋势市场中表现良好
ReOpen功能允许趋势延续时加仓，提高盈利潜力
参数简洁明了，便于用户调整和优化
pros_en: Clear trend-following strategy logic that performs well in strong trending markets
ReOpen feature allows position addition during trend continuation, enhancing profit potential
Simple and straightforward parameters, easy for users to adjust and optimize
cons: ReOpen加仓功能可能导致总持仓量过大，风险敞口难以控制
缺少追踪止损功能，趋势反转时可能回吐大量利润
在震荡行情中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: ReOpen pyramiding feature may lead to excessive total position size with uncontrolled risk exposure
Lacks trailing stop functionality, potentially giving back significant profits on trend reversals
Prone to frequent false signals in ranging/choppy markets leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加最大同方向持仓数量限制，防止ReOpen过度加仓
添加追踪止损或趋势强度过滤条件，减少震荡市中的假信号
improvements_en: Add a maximum same-direction position count limit to prevent excessive pyramiding via ReOpen
Add trailing stop or trend strength filter conditions to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: ReOpen功能可能导致同方向累积持仓过大，超出账户承受能力
如果止损设为0，则完全没有风险保护，单笔交易可能造成重大亏损
risk_points_en: ReOpen feature may cause cumulative same-direction positions to exceed account capacity
If StopLoss is set to 0, there is no risk protection and a single trade may cause significant losses
